Subject: Disappointing Experience Regarding Hidden Membership Conditions
Dear Lenskart Team,
I recently visited one of your stores for an eye test and a purchase. While your staff was polite and explained the "Buy 1 Get 2 Free for ₹5000" offer, I was extremely disappointed by the lack of transparency.
After spending more than an hour at the store completing the eye test and selecting frames, I was suddenly informed at the billing counter that I would need to purchase an additional store membership to avail of this offer. This crucial condition was completely hidden from me when the offer was initially pitched.
Wasting a customer's time for over an hour and surprising them with mandatory hidden charges at the last minute is extremely unprofessional and frustrating. I expect better transparency and respect for customer time from a brand like Lenskart.
Looking forward to a prompt response regarding this practice.
Regards,
